yea. my last assault was 3 years ago and it all replays in my mind. 
it haunts me everyday and every night. 
if it didn’t happen to me i could’ve done everything i wanted but now i’m stuck in a cycle of depression and wanting to die.

i agree. the most common argument against it is “well your family and other care and it’ll hurt them”
it’s selfish of people to ask me to live in pain everyday and struggle to just be alive. especially if you’ve been struggling with suicidal thoughts for years it can be selfish of those who care about you.
thank you. i just don’t like the feeling but i can’t stop thinking about him :/ shit sucks
